content.short: Ray Network is an advanced DeFi ecosystem on Cardano providing a wide range of open-source blockchain tools.
content.description: Ray Network is a comprehensive, multi-functional ecosystem built on the Cardano blockchain to provide a suite of advanced DeFi solutions. The platform includes a feature-rich light wallet, a decentralized exchange, an NFT marketplace, and various API provisioning tools for developers. Powered by the XRAY governance token, the project is designed for community-led growth and long-term sustainability. Ray Network aims to simplify the blockchain experience for both users and builders by offering an open-source framework that supports the efficient management and trading of digital assets.
